summary: Letter-key re-extraction checked 365 rows; 9 mismatches (Evanjelicke section-collision, X7 dual answer-key collision, X4 item with no official letter). Restated Cielene B/C/D sample n=30: 13 confirmed, 12 wrong, 5 uncertain. Restated bank keys are ~84% D (vs ~23% D on letter-key rows)—consistent with infer_restated_key falling back to last-choice text when Riesenie only restates the MCQ. Úlohy spot-check 20/20 confirmed. Recommendation: reject_batch — do not publish restated keys; fix letter-key multi-section pairs before keep.
